messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell your doctor if you have a serious illness, a fever, an infection, surgery, or a medical emergency"
set: ["tell your doctor if you have a serious illness, a fever, an infection, surgery, or a medical emergency", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery", "tell your doctor if you have a thyroid disorder", "tell your doctor or pharmacist if you have a latex allergy", "tell your doctor right away if you have a fever", "tell your doctor if you have a muscle weakness condition", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery or dental procedure", "call your doctor at once if you have a serious side effect", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "tell your doctor if you have a history of drug or alcohol addiction", "call your doctor right away if you have a fever", "tell your doctor if side effects bother you a lot", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "call your doctor if you have trouble swallowing a capsule or tablet", "get medical help right away if you have a fever", "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have blood in your urine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
